options.name: io_size_bytes
options.description:
Sets the size of IO for static and capacity limit definitions. The number of IOs per request is obtained by
dividing request size by IO size. Default: 64K, Recommended range: 4K - 1M (optional filter)

options.name: is_default
options.description: Is default User QOS Policy (optional filter)

options.name: is_gold
options.description: Grants priority QoS over views that do not have this setting enabled. (optional filter)

options.name: limit_by
options.description:
Specifies which performance parameter(s) are limited by the policy. BW_IOPS=The policy limits service according
to bandwidth (BW) and IO per second (IOPS). BW=The policy limits service according to BW only. IOPS=The policy
limits service according to IOPS only. (optional filter)

options.name: mode
options.description:
The mode of provisioning quality of service per view. STATIC=read and/or write BW and/or IOPS may be limited to a
set maximum limit. USED_CAPACITY=BW and IOPS may be limited set per unit of used logical capacity. Static limits
are also configurable and define boundaries of performance allowance. PROVISIONED_CAPACITY=BW and IOPS may be
limited per unit of logical capacity, as provisioned by the soft limit of a quota on the view path. Static limits
are also configurable and define boundaries of pe

options.name: policy_type
options.description: QOS Policy type - VIEW or USER (optional filter)

options.name: s3_connections_limit
options.description: Maximum number of allowed S3 connections, 0 means unlimited (optional filter)

options.name: use_total_limits
options.description: If true - total limits are used instead of separate read/write limits. (optional filter)
